reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getMonthWideCategories/getMonthWideBudgetCategories selection used by setZero, the averages and last-month spending, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own filter chain instead of using that selection.

duplication.why: The 'hidden unless included' rule is now written twice, once in SQL in getMonthWideCategories ('? = 1 OR ...') and once in JS in copyPreviousMonth ('!includeHiddenCategories && ...').

placement.why: The variation is a parameter of the shared category selection in budget/actions.ts, where the month-wide rules live.

scope.why: Focused on the flag; the switch of the average actions to a shared MonthWideArgs type is a small, related tidy-up.

maintainability.why: A single explicit parameter on the shared selection is easy to own; the remaining parallel filter in copyPreviousMonth must be kept in step by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth applies the hidden/template/fixed exclusions itself instead of going through getMonthWideCategories

disguised_duplication.where: The includeHiddenCategories rule appears as an SQL predicate in getMonthWideCategories and as a JS guard in copyPreviousMonth
